$comment: §33.1 completeness accounting by the dividing unit of the instrument — the ARTICLE ("ARTICLE 2.1.11" in capitals on a line of its own, the title in brackets on the next line). The unit is declared explicitly: unit=en_article_upper_dotted. The accounting number uses underscores ("2.1.11" → "2_1_11"), the en_article_dotted convention. The scope numbers are written WITH UNDERSCORES ("2_1_11"): that is the form the convention produces and the form both §33.1 measures read.
note: The scope of THIS package is chapters 1, 4 and 5 of the Principles: general provisions, interpretation of the contract, and content, third party rights and conditions. It is the hub of the `unidroit.picc*` group; the other chapters belong to the neighbouring packages of the same group, each with its own copy of the same bytes and its own scope.
